# Hyperliquid Liquidation Events (Mar 22 – May 25, 2025)

Every liquidation trade on Hyperliquid perps over a 65-day window,
reconstructed from Hyperliquid's public node-trade archive — **346,130
events across 179 coins**, including the full long tail of meme-coin
perps that aggregated liquidation products (heatmaps, BTC/ETH-only free
tiers) don't cover.

## Files

| file | format | size |
|---|---|---|
| `liquidation_events.parquet` | Parquet | ~10 MB |
| `liquidation_events.csv.gz` | gzipped CSV | ~6.7 MB |

Identical content, one row per liquidation trade.

## Schema

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `time` | int64 | trade timestamp, Unix milliseconds (UTC) |
| `coin` | string | perp market symbol (e.g. `BTC`, `FARTCOIN`) |
| `px` | float | trade price |
| `sz` | float | trade size, in units of the coin |
| `side` | string | `B` = forced buy (a short was liquidated), `A` = forced sell (a long was liquidated) |
| `liquidated_start_pos` | float | signed position of the liquidated account before the event (negative = short) |
| `notional_usd` | float | `px * sz`, rounded to cents |
| `hash` | string | on-chain transaction hash (verifiable on any Hyperliquid explorer) |

A single position liquidation can produce several rows (the
liquidation order fills against multiple resting orders). Group by
`coin` + `liquidated_start_pos` + close timestamps to approximate
position-level events.

## Source & method

Hyperliquid publishes raw node data in a public requester-pays S3
bucket (`hl-mainnet-node-data`). This dataset filters node trades to
`trade_dir_override = "LiquidatedMarket"` — i.e. actual forced
liquidation fills, not mark-price crossings or estimates. Coverage:
2025-03-22 10:56 UTC → 2025-05-25 14:23 UTC, continuous.

## Quick start

```python
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_parquet("liquidation_events.parquet")
df["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"], unit="ms")
df.groupby("coin")["notional_usd"].sum().nlargest(20)
```
